## About
Rain City Wheel Repair & Coatings is a wheel and tire shop on NE 126th Place in Kirkland. We fix curbed and damaged wheels, do wheel coatings, and sell, install and service tires for all vehicle makes and models.
Drivers come to us from Kirkland, Bellevue, Bothell and beyond. Reviewers mention Shane by name, and say he explains the work before it starts. We're rated 5 on Google from 110 reviews.

## Services
- Wheel Repair: Curbed edges, pothole damage, scratches and paint dimples. One reviewer's forged wheel came back repaired to factory new.
- Wheel Coatings: Change the look of your wheels. One customer had his blacked out and called the price reasonable.
- TPMS Repair: Tire pressure monitoring system service, because underinflated tires put performance and passenger safety at risk.
- Computerized Wheel Balancing: Wheels balanced on computerized equipment for a smooth ride.
- Tire Purchase & Tire Installation: Car, truck and SUV tires from leading brands, mounted here at the shop.
- Tire Repair: Repairs for the tires you already have.
- Tire Rotation: Regular rotation to help your tires wear evenly.
- Wheel Purchase & Wheel Installation: Shop custom wheels and have them installed.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Kirkland, Bellevue, Bothell and the surrounding areas.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Passenger cars, medium sized trucks, mini-vans and SUVs, across a variety of makes and models.

Q: Can I send photos of the damage first?
A: One customer got started by sending over photos of her car, and Shane let her know the wheels could be repaired.
